blocks.text: The Senate will not allocate funding for Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) projects that fail to submit the required supporting documents, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said, explaining the removal of billions of pesos worth of infrastructure projects from the proposed budget.
